• Developing AI methods to quantify tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes from H&E whole-slide images in triple-negative breast cancer.
  • Studying whether the biomarker stays reliable across patient populations and imaging sources, with a focus on African and Moroccan cohorts.

• Developing AI models that predict mutations from whole-slide images (94% benchmark accuracy).
  • Applied computational-pathology and precision-oncology research.
• Engineered an end-to-end EGFR mutation prediction pipeline from whole-slide images, outperforming existing solutions by 15% on benchmark datasets.

• TIL spatial quantification & tumour subtype classification (2024–2025): multi-task foundation model for joint TIL quantification and adenocarcinoma / adenoma classification.
  • Breast cancer detection AI (2023–2024): computer-vision system, 94% accuracy, 60% faster diagnosis, validated against physician annotations.

• Co-organised the 1st Congress of Digital Pathology.
  • Represented DataPathology at two further international AI-in-oncology conferences.
  • Earlier (2023 – 2025): taught English, algorithms and logic to young learners through summer camps and workshops.
